title: cadetia chionantha
intro: Cadetia chionantha, commonly known as the 'Purple Cone Flower', is a flowering plant species within the family Iridaceae. This plant is known for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, making it useful in treating various health conditions such as arthritis, wounds, and infections. The bioactive constituents of Cadetia chionantha include flavonoids, glycosides, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
